title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the personal data of users of www.danielecamiz.com.
data_collected_list: Data provided directly by users (e.g., name, email, messages sent)
Browsing data (cookies, IP addresses, access logs)
purpose_text: Data is used to provide requested services, improve user experience, and send informational or promotional communications with consent.

rights_text: Users may exercise their rights of access, rectification, deletion, restriction, objection, and portability by contacting info@danielecamiz.com.
